t: This is Campden Grove, a street in the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea. George Lyon died here in 1850. He was a merchant in the City of London, born in 1770, so he lived to about eighty. The material doesn't tell us what he traded in or how his business fared, so I won't guess. What's recorded is that a City merchant, whose life ran from the Georgian era into the Victorian, spent his last days on this street.
